outcome.reason: Refund authorized. Razorpay confirmed the payment is refundable for this amount, and a signed manager approval covers this payment and amount.

description: Authorizes a refund on a Razorpay payment. Razorpay itself confirms the payment is captured, not fully refunded, and has the requested amount left. A signed manager approval for that payment and amount is also required. The caller cannot declare either fact.
